baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction لمن شاء ... أن يستقيم joins an addressed human will at word 2 to the purposive outcome يستقيم at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Will takes straightness, evenness, and upright alignment as its intended object; the verse is not only permission but a vector from choosing toward bringing an aligned state about.

activation_trace.role: Willing toward, and potentially bringing about or attaining, a thing supplies the initiating volitional vector.
Straightness, uprightness, and evenness supply the vector's explicit target state.

changed_reading.before: A general invitation to behave correctly.
changed_reading.after: An address to anyone whose will takes straight and even alignment as something to intend and enact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes شاء and يستقيم, allowing inward attraction at word 2 to be tested by an inceptive rising at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: A felt pull toward the good becomes resolve and bodily or practical rising to undertake it; willing is completed as mobilization rather than left as preference.

activation_trace.role: The self being drawn or delighted by something supplies inward attraction as the mechanism's first phase.
Bodily standing and rising turn attraction into an embodied change of posture.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter give the posture an agentive task rather than a merely geometric shape.

changed_reading.before: Wanting guidance as an inward preference.
changed_reading.after: Letting attraction become resolve, rising, and practical undertaking.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form يستقيم can activate the ق و م field of guarding, maintaining, and providing what lets a thing stand.
baseline_models.mechanism: Uprightness is durative maintenance: the will repeatedly guards an orientation and supplies the support by which a life or order remains standing.

activation_trace.role: Volition supplies the repeated commitment that maintains rather than merely enters the state.
Care, guardianship, preservation, and perseverance supply active maintenance as a mode of uprightness.
Support, mainstay, and subsistence make straightening the production of conditions by which something can keep standing.

changed_reading.before: A one-time correction onto a straight line.
changed_reading.after: The sustained work of guarding an orientation and becoming a support through which right order can continue.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ق و م inventory behind يستقيم includes resurrection and creatures standing before their Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: Present willing can be heard as choosing a posture fit for a future rising and standing; ethical straightening becomes anticipatory readiness.

activation_trace.role: Will toward an attainable state supplies present choice and preparation.
Resurrection and the standing of creatures supply a future standing latent within the focus root.

changed_reading.before: Straight conduct confined to the present path.
changed_reading.after: Choosing now to become ready for a later rising and standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun is folded, stars lose their ordered appearance, mountains are displaced, and the sky-cover is removed. Against that loss of external coordinates, يستقيم becomes the willing adoption of a bearing that survives the collapse of familiar markers rather than mere conformity to an intact visible layout.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and even alignment anchor the changed reading in the focus verb.
Wrapping and folding with parts gathered reconfigures the sun from a stable public marker into a withdrawn one.
Scattered plunging and collapse dissolve the stars' apparent fixed pattern.
Removal and displacement carry away even the landscape's massive reference points.
Removing a cover and exposing what was hidden adds revelation of a frame beyond the lost visible markers.

structural_cues: The repeated passive إذا clauses of 81:1-3 remove the sun, stars, and mountains from their ordinary orienting roles.
The later stripping of the sky in 81:11 turns deorientation into exposure rather than simple annihilation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transformed cosmic and terrestrial markers; I infer that their ordinary function as coordinates makes their loss causally relevant to the focus's straightness. A live alternative is that they only stage the final event while يستقيم retains an ordinary ethical sense.

changed_reading.before: Choose to align with the stable order one can already see.
changed_reading.after: Choose and preserve a bearing even when the familiar order used to measure direction is folded, scattered, moved, and stripped away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Possessions are emptied of use, the unsocial are gathered, selves are paired, and a killed child becomes the center of interrogation about guilt. The focus's willing-to-stand therefore acquires a public and relational edge: rise into a just, answerable position when inherited valuations and group arrangements are overturned.

activation_trace.role: Will toward an enacted state keeps the social reading attached to the focus's human choice.
The group and kin field lets standing straight concern one's position among people rather than an isolated posture.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter anchor the demand to take an answerable stand.
Vacancy, abandonment, and disabling empty a prized possession of its old social priority.
The opposite of sociability supplies beings normally outside human association.
Driving and gathering a group toward one destination reverses that isolation into compulsory collectivity.
Making one thing the counterpart of another reconstitutes selves through relation and comparison.
Questioning across parties makes answerability, rather than inherited status, organize the scene.
Guilt and offense supply the disputed moral category applied to the victim.
Taking life supplies the irreversible social wrong around which the demand for a just stand turns.

structural_cues: The passive sequence in 81:4-9 moves property, wild collectives, selves, and a killed child through abandonment, gathering, pairing, and interrogation.
At 81:8 the branchless root و ء د at word 2 marks the harmed patient before the passive question; it is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversals of possession, association, pairing, questioning, guilt, and killing; I infer that their sequence reorders social value and makes uprightness an answerable stance toward others. Alternatively, the list may universalize upheaval without specifically socializing يستقيم.

changed_reading.before: Privately improve one's own moral posture.
changed_reading.after: Will to rise into a just and answerable position when collective priorities are overturned and the harmed are placed at the center.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written surfaces are opened, a covering is stripped, and each self knows what it has brought present. Sustained uprightness becomes continuity that remains legible when hidden layers are unfolded: a maintained course whose products can be presented to its own agent.

activation_trace.role: Guarding, maintaining, and persevering anchor the course as durable practice rather than a last-moment pose.
Straightness and evenness supply the quality tested across the disclosed course.
A written sheet supplies the durable surface on which a course can leave an inspectable trace.
Opening, spreading, and branching expose what had been folded together.
Removing the cover supplies a second disclosure operation at cosmic scale.
The thing becoming uncovered to its knower completes disclosure as self-recognition.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness make prior action stand before the self as its own brought result.

structural_cues: The disclosure sequence runs from opened records in 81:10 through stripped covering in 81:11 to self-knowledge of what was brought in 81:14.
The subject نفس and the relative ما ... أحضرت make the revealed product belong to the same agent whose course is at issue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies records, opening, stripping, knowing, and brought presence; I infer that disclosure tests continuity between hidden conduct and visible result. A live alternative is that these are consequences of judgment and do not describe the internal mechanics of straightening.

changed_reading.before: Maintain a correct direction whether or not it leaves a coherent trace.
changed_reading.after: Maintain a course whose hidden and visible phases remain continuous enough to be unfolded, recognized, and presented as one's own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath sequence alternates withdrawal, running, sheltering, thinning darkness, and breathing dawn. It prevents uprightness from hardening into immobility: the maintained orientation can move, disappear from view, return, and open like breath while retaining its course.

activation_trace.role: Persevering maintenance anchors continuity through changing phases.
Stopping, freezing, and exhaustion supply a live negative edge: a merely fixed posture can cease to be a viable course.
Withdrawal into concealment or delay supplies a phase in which continued orientation is not publicly visible.
Flowing movement supplies active continuity rather than static position.
Entering a shelter makes concealment compatible with an ongoing patterned course.
Thin darkness at either edge of night supplies an ambiguous transition rather than a fixed binary state.
Morning opening like a breath gives the changing course a rhythmic emergence.

structural_cues: The paired oath images in 81:15-18 move from celestial withdrawal and running through the edge of night to dawn's opening.
The sequence holds concealment and manifestation together instead of treating one phase as loss of direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a patterned alternation of motion, hiding, transition, and opening; I infer a temporal analogy in which constancy belongs to orientation across phases, not to visible immobility. Alternatively, these images may certify the message without modeling human istiqama.

changed_reading.before: To be straight is to remain visibly fixed and unchanged.
changed_reading.after: To remain oriented through withdrawal, movement, shelter, ambiguity, and renewed opening without freezing into exhausted stoppage.

context_deltas.mechanism: A trustworthy chain of saying, deliberate transmission, confidence, direct seeing, and clarification is contrasted with hiddenness, crooked remoteness, and conjectural speech about the unseen. The focus's rare listening branch of شاء joins يستقيم so that uprightness can include calibrating attention and judgment to a warranted source.

activation_trace.role: Listening closely supplies a receptive mode latent in the focus's act of willing.
Straight and even alignment supplies the calibration achieved by warranted reception.
A thing's saying as its indication supplies meaningful evidence, not sound alone.
Gentleness and deliberateness supply controlled transmission rather than erratic utterance.
Settled confidence and trust supply the warranted receiver stance toward the messenger.
Seeing by eye and insight supplies direct encounter as a check on the transmission.
Making meaning clear through speech or sign supplies intelligibility at the horizon.
What is screened from eyes identifies the difficult evidential domain across which the message is carried.
Opposition, crookedness, and severity supply the rejected counter-source's anti-alignment.
Conjectural speech about the unseen supplies the specifically excluded epistemic failure.

structural_cues: Verses 81:19-21 accumulate positive source credentials before 81:22-25 negate madness, withholding, and a deviant source.
The witnessed clear horizon and the unseen are placed in one evidential chain before the focus asks for willing straightness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source credentials, witnessing, clarity, hidden content, and explicit counter-source negations; I infer that source evaluation causally enables the receiver's alignment. A live alternative is that the credentials only defend revelation while يستقيم denotes conduct without an epistemic component.

changed_reading.before: Straightening is primarily moral motion after a message has already been accepted.
changed_reading.after: Straightening also occurs in reception: listen closely, discriminate warranted transmission from crooked conjecture, and align judgment with what has been reliably shown.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spatial challenge أين تذهبون is followed by a reminder and then لمن شاء ... أن يستقيم. This adjacency turns the focus into a route correction: willing straightness answers a live question about where one's current motion and method are going.

activation_trace.role: Willing toward an attainable object supplies the choice to redirect an existing trajectory.
Straightness supplies the corrected direction named by the focus.
Going and proceeding supply an already active trajectory rather than a static location.
A path, place, or method makes أين concern both destination and adopted way.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the wayfinding interruption between misdirected going and straightening.

structural_cues: The three-verse progression asks where the audience is going, identifies the discourse as a reminder, and then names willing straightness.
The second-person plural of 81:26 narrows to the distributive لمن شاء منكم in 81:28, converting a collective challenge into individual uptake.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a destination question, a path-method branch, a reminder, and immediate straightness; I infer that adjacency makes 81:28 a practical answer to 81:26. Alternatively, أين may remain only a rebuke and the reminder a universal notice rather than a route marker.

changed_reading.before: A detached universal maxim about anyone who happens to want rectitude.
changed_reading.after: The offered correction to an audience already in motion: remember, inspect where your adopted way goes, and choose a straight course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus affirms whoever wills, while 81:29 repeats human and divine willing inside an exception and names lordship as sovereignty, repair, completion, and continuance. Human willing remains a real local vector, but its ability to reach and maintain uprightness is nested within a larger enabling and sustaining will.

activation_trace.role: The singular human act of willing supplies genuine local agency in the focus.
Maintenance and preservation make completion of straightening depend on more than an initial preference.
The shared branch across human and divine verbs makes the two wills coexist in one compact dependency construction.
The worshiped deity identifies the higher agency named after the exception.
Sovereignty and lordship supply the encompassing agency within which human choice operates.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply an enabling rather than merely restrictive relation to human straightening.
Continuance and abiding supply the sustained horizon in which a chosen orientation can endure.

structural_cues: The human willing affirmed in 81:28 is repeated in plural at 81:29 and placed before إلا أن يشاء الله.
The title رب العالمين follows the exception, so the larger will is also framed as governing and sustaining the whole field of agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated willing, exception syntax, divine naming, and lordship branches; I infer nested agency in which the larger will enables, completes, or sustains the smaller. Permission, concurrence, causal enablement, and overriding constraint remain materially live alternatives, so this delta does not erase the human willing stated in 81:28.

changed_reading.before: The individual independently originates and completes the movement into uprightness.
changed_reading.after: The individual genuinely wills a straight course, while that willing and its endurance coexist within an encompassing will that can govern, repair, complete, and sustain it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates commercial valuation and exact coin-weight branches inside يستقيم. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains mechanism from the opened written record and self-recognition in 81:10-14; downstream prose should present it as an appraisal analogy, not replace the ordinary straightness sense with pricing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At word 5, the ق و م inventory includes valuation and an exact, non-overweight measure alongside straightness.

activation_trace.role: Value, appraisal, and pricing supply a test of what the chosen course is worth when assessed.
Equal weight and exact measure supply precision rather than vague moral approximation.
The written sheet supplies the record against which exact appraisal becomes imaginable.
Published writing makes the record available for assessment.
Disclosure to the knower turns appraisal into the self's recognition of its own measure.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is only spatial or generally moral.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, to straighten is to become exact enough that one's unfolded course can bear honest valuation without hidden excess or deficit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the branch of a blind eye whose globe remains physically intact as a negative possibility inside the focus root. The contrast remains anchored in يستقيم and is activated by seeing at the clear horizon in 81:23; downstream prose must mark it as a cautionary counter-image, not claim that يستقيم lexically means seeing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ق و م branch inventory at word 5 distinguishes an outwardly standing eye from retained sight.

activation_trace.role: An intact standing eye with lost vision supplies the danger of exterior uprightness without perceptual capacity.
Vision by eye and insight supplies the positive capacity absent from the standing-but-blind counter-image.
Manifest appearance and disclosure make the horizon available to perception.

changed_reading.before: An intact outward posture is enough to count as standing straight.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, uprightness must not be a standing but sightless exterior; it includes responsiveness to what becomes clearly visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapped ر ب و growth branch under the QAC root ر ب ب. It remains anchored in the focus's standing and support branches and is reinforced by the dominant repair-and-nurture branch at 81:29; downstream prose should qualify it as a material growth model of enabling lordship, not as a lexical gloss of رب in this verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At word 5, يستقيم can evoke both upright standing and the support by which a living thing remains standing.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily and plant standing supply the focus-side shape of cultivated growth.
Mainstay and subsistence supply the conditions that let uprightness continue.
Repair, nurture, and completion provide the dominant branch-backed enabling action.
The non-dominant nourishment and growth branch supplies the exploratory material analogy of uprightness developing under cultivation.

changed_reading.before: Divine willing only limits the independent human decision to stand straight.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the encompassing will also repairs, feeds, and grows the conditions under which human uprightness can emerge and remain standing.

strongest_changes: The collapse of ordinary cosmic markers changes straightness from conformity to a visible fixed layout into a bearing that can survive deorientation.
The credentialed and witnessed transmission activates a strong epistemic reading: willing straightness includes listening, source discrimination, and alignment of judgment with warranted disclosure.
The route question and reminder make 81:28 an immediate correction of an audience already going somewhere, while 81:29 nests that real human redirection within divine willing and sustaining lordship.
The social reversals and interrogation of the killed child prevent uprightness from remaining private; it becomes a just and answerable stand among reconstituted relations.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots carried unusually different mechanisms at once: attraction becoming resolve, straightness as maintenance, future standing, epistemic listening, exact appraisal, and even the warning of an intact but sightless standing eye. Context did not disambiguate them into one answer; it made several coexist as spatial, social, temporal, evidential, eschatological, and cultivated readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The cosmic and oath sequences may model human orientation, or may only authenticate and stage the message that calls for ordinary rectitude.
The exception in 81:29 establishes dependence but does not by itself settle whether the operative relation is permission, concurrence, causal enablement, completion, or overriding constraint.

The appraisal, blind-eye, and non-dominant growth activations are deliberately retained but require explicit exploratory qualification because their branch mechanisms are distant from the surface forms.
